thread:
Maria: FYI — FinServ asked for p95=200ms p99=550ms on hosted endpoints and wants no throughput hit. need to align on what we can promise.
Jon (sales): they sounded firm on p95 but said p99 can be softer if we explain cold/warmup windows. pricing will be sensitive.
Sara (product): Can we present an engineered compromise? maybe tighten p95 and allow a p99 carveout during cold starts. need numbers.
Maria: Quick profiling snapshot from last night (microbench with model-x, 8xA100):
```
config: { microbatch_target: 1, max_batch_delay_ms: 8, kv_cache_policy: "auto", kernel_pref: "fp16_fused" }
run@peak: 20 qps/core steady, microburst test 500r/s for 30s
results:
  microbatch=1 -> p95 212ms, p99 565ms, throughput 95 req/s
  microbatch=4 -> p95 248ms, p99 910ms, throughput 180 req/s
notes: KV cold fills add ~180-320ms tail depending on seq len; kernel_v2 path adds ~15-25% p99 under microburst (investigating)
```
Maria: TL;DR: to keep throughput we need larger microbatches which worsen p99 a lot. KV warmup is the single biggest tail source.
Kevin (cust-success): FinServ will accept a p99 carveout if we document it and provide a mitigation plan (pre-warm, scheduled ramp, or warmup credits). they care most about p95 latency during business hours.
Sara (product): Proposal draft:
  - Tiered SLO: p95 <= 250ms (hard), p99 <= 750ms (soft, 99.8% of steady-state traffic), carveouts for first 10m after deploy or traffic cold-windows.
  - Offer a dedicated warmup run for first-day traffic and optional KV pinning for an additional fee.
Jon (sales): That sounds sellable. we can structure pricing: base price for p95 guarantee + optional warmup/pinning add-on. avoids big sticker shock. :thumbsup:
Maria: Practical mitigations engineering can deliver in short term:
  - KV pinning experiment (pin hot prefixes to RAM) -> reduces cold tail by ~120ms in perf run
  - Kernel rollback or targeted patch for kernel_v2 evictions (we saw a regression in microburst)
  - Auto-fallback routing to quantized model variant for burst periods (lowers p99 but may impact quality)
Sara (product): Can eng run a 24h synthetic sim with 10% bursty traffic (5x for 30s every 5min) and record p95/p99 across microbatch configs + KV pinning on/off? Need artifacts to put in the contract appendix.
Maria: Yep — I can kick that off. initial ETA 48h for a baseline run, 72h for full matrix. will include flamegraphs and kernel path breakdown.
Jon (sales): Also need one pager that frames tradeoffs for customer-facing conversation (simple bullets + numbers). I'll draft once eng provides numbers.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline: perf-sim job queued (#3942). started: 1919191932.
Maria: Current risk: kernel_v2 patch we rolled last week appears to cause KV eviction thrash under microburst; tracking as P0 for perf team. will attempt targeted fix; if not, we should consider temporary rollback for this customer's fleet if they sign.
Kevin (cust-success): I'll pre-emptively explain the carveout language to FinServ and see what mitigations they prefer.
Maria: Action items -> eng: run 24h sim + KV pinning test; infra: enable test pin config on a staging pool; product: finalize tiered SLO wording; sales: prepare pricing + one-pager. ping me for blockers. :white_check_mark:
Sara (product): Agree. thanks everyone.
Jon (sales): Good plan. I'll loop in account exec and legal after we have numbers.
Maria: Closing for now — will post results thread with perf artifacts (tarball + flamegraphs) when sims finish.
Jon (sales): Thanks.
